    Monomial algebras and their representations #

    MonomialData k A is path data whose path values span A and whose nonzero path values are linearly independent; equivalently A ≅ kQ/I with I spanned by the paths it contains. This is the setting of string algebras.

    A representation (Rep) of the quiver on a k-vector space in which the zero paths act as zero becomes an A-module (Rep.Carrier), with e v and α a acting by the given maps. A k-linear map between A-modules commuting with the vertex and arrow actions is A-linear (linearMap_of_commute).
